speaker: Working Passage / Vale and Castle
status: Current authored briefing (2026-10-14 script pass); every turn recorded, transcript-checked and promoted

lines.text: My haulers are loaded and going nowhere. The roaches have dug in on the outer road, and two nights ago another crew's boat came down at the quarry.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [tired, frustrated] My haulers are loaded and going nowhere. The roaches have dug in on the outer road, and two nights ago another crew's boat came down at the quarry.

lines.text: So they're waiting for your shipment to move.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [measured] So they're waiting for your shipment to move.

lines.text: They're waiting for it to move without you beside it. I need the road opened to the eastern yard, with positions along it my militia can hold after you've gone.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [grim] They're waiting for it to move without you beside it. I need the road opened to the eastern yard, with positions along it my militia can hold after you've gone.

lines.text: Positions built by what?
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [curious] Positions built by what?

lines.text: By Morrow. Teo and the fitters have her lift working. She'll hover. She can crawl the road behind you and put her builders down wherever you've cleared.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [practical] By Morrow. Teo and the fitters have her lift working. She'll hover. She can crawl the road behind you and put her builders down wherever you've cleared.

lines.text: That's a bigger job than the yard. What does it pay?
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [businesslike] That's a bigger job than the yard. What does it pay?

lines.text: A share when the shipment sells.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [careful] A share when the shipment sells.

lines.text: When it sells. To a buyer we don't know, for cargo you won't describe, out past a crew that's already shown it'll kill for it.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [skeptical, pointed] When it sells. To a buyer we don't know, for cargo you won't describe, out past a crew that's already shown it'll kill for it.

lines.text: You've had every credit I owed you, on time. Wayline hasn't, so you can guess who I paid first.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [stung, proud] You've had every credit I owed you, on time. Wayline hasn't, so you can guess who I paid first.

lines.text: We have, and I'd like it to stay that way. Our payroll doesn't wait on your buyer.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [acknowledging, firm] We have, and I'd like it to stay that way. Our payroll doesn't wait on your buyer.

lines.text: Then what do you want?
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [impatient] Then what do you want?

lines.text: Morrow.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [simple, steady] Morrow.

lines.text: No.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [flat refusal] No.

lines.text: She's the best thing in this yard that isn't in the Colossus. Her bay was meant to carry this camp through the season, and now she flies, she's worth three times that.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [heated, protective] She's the best thing in this yard that isn't in the Colossus. Her bay was meant to carry this camp through the season, and now she flies, she's worth three times that.

lines.text: Who are you going to sell her to?
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [calm] Who are you going to sell her to?

lines.text: That's my business.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [curt] That's my business.

lines.text: Whoever buys a flying Shepherd has to register her at a Hegemony port. Somebody asks where she came from. Then somebody asks what else came down in this valley.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [quiet, deliberate] Whoever buys a flying Shepherd has to register her at a Hegemony port. Somebody asks where she came from. Then somebody asks what else came down in this valley.

lines.text: Is that a threat?
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [cold, wary] Is that a threat?

lines.text: It's a reason. We've no interest in telling anyone anything. A mercenary company coming out of a wreck field with a recovered hull is nobody's news. It's how we got our first ship.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [even, reassuring] It's a reason. We've no interest in telling anyone anything. A mercenary company coming out of a wreck field with a recovered hull is nobody's news. It's how we got our first ship.

lines.text: Take her for the job, then. Bring her back when the road's done, and I'll pay you out of the shipment on top.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [bargaining] Take her for the job, then. Bring her back when the road's done, and I'll pay you out of the shipment on top.

lines.text: That's the same promise with a ship attached.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [dry] That's the same promise with a ship attached.

lines.text: Then hear mine. You get the hull and nothing else. Every spare we've already pulled off her stays here. The guns she builds stay here. Not a credit for the road, and not a bolt out of the Colossus.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [hard, conceding] Then hear mine. You get the hull and nothing else. Every spare we've already pulled off her stays here. The guns she builds stay here. Not a credit for the road, and not a bolt out of the Colossus.

lines.text: Agreed.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [immediate] Agreed.

lines.text: And she's not yours until the road's handed to my militia and she's clear of this basin. You don't lift while my people are still walking into position.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [firm] And she's not yours until the road's handed to my militia and she's clear of this basin. You don't lift while my people are still walking into position.

lines.text: They'll have cover all the way up. We hand over each position before we move on. Who's flying her?
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [steady] They'll have cover all the way up. We hand over each position before we move on. Who's flying her?

lines.text: Your own people. Nobody from Basin goes with her. Not Teo, not anyone.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [sharp, protective] Your own people. Nobody from Basin goes with her. Not Teo, not anyone.

lines.text: I wasn't going to ask.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [light, honest] I wasn't going to ask.

lines.text: Good. Teo will walk your crew through her before the drive test. Then he comes home.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [softening slightly] Good. Teo will walk your crew through her before the drive test. Then he comes home.

lines.text: We'll put a crew across from Second Wind. Both ships will be running thin until we can hire. Send the terms and I'll put it to the Captain.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [practical] We'll put a crew across from Second Wind. Both ships will be running thin until we can hire. Send the terms and I'll put it to the Captain.

lines.text: I'll send them. Get her out in one piece, Castle. I've watched enough ships come down in this valley.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [quiet, weary] I'll send them. Get her out in one piece, Castle. I've watched enough ships come down in this valley.

lines.text: Morrow's holding a hover. Bring her along the road to the eastern yard. Clear the pump bend and use Build Vulcan Turret on ground her builders can reach, then do the same at the narrows. Cover the work and wait for my militia to take over. Keep the company with her for the drive test. If the drives give out, break off and we'll recover her. The deal stands either way.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [focused, practical] Morrow's holding a hover. Bring her along the road to the eastern yard. Clear the pump bend and use Build Vulcan Turret on ground her builders can reach, then do the same at the narrows. Cover the work and wait for my militia to take over. Keep the company with her for the drive test. If the drives give out, break off and we'll recover her. The deal stands either way.
